review.posthog_relevance: Updates the Content Security Policy (CSP) middleware implementation to use HTTP response headers compatible with CSP Report Only and Reporting API v4, replacing the deprecated v3 and report-only directive manipulation. This improves compatibility and adherence to current browser standards for security reporting.
review.reason: The production implementation P1.F2 demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness and compatibility improvement by removing deprecated v3 and report-only header manipulation and adopting v4 and report-uri. review.uncertainty: The tier relies on P1.F2; P1.F1 and P1.F3 do not demonstrate tier-3 systemic benefit. No test failures or runtime behavior changes are observed, so the benefit is implementation-dependent compatibility rather than demonstrated runtime improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. The production implementation is in P1.F2, but P1.F3 and P1.F1 do not demonstrate the tier.
